quality_guards: Beauty-treatment risk depends on product chemistry, treatment type, ventilation, extraction, contact duration, hygiene and worker sensitisation.
Beauty and nail-bar evidence is product-, task-, exposure-, workplace- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Dry-cleaning solvent risk depends on solvent identity, machine integrity, loading and unloading, spotting, ventilation, maintenance and exposure duration.
Dry-cleaning evidence is solvent-, process-, machine-, task- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level toxicity probability.
Embalming risk depends on the condition of the deceased, procedure, formaldehyde concentration, ventilation, sharps, hygiene, PPE and worker competence.
Embalming evidence is chemical-, procedure-, infection-, facility- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Dental risk depends on glove material, wet-work frequency, cleaning chemicals, instruments, sharps, decontamination and individual skin condition.
Dentistry evidence is procedure-, instrument-, exposure-, patient- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level dermatitis or infection probability.
Tyre risk depends on wheel type, pressure, tyre condition, seating, restraint, inflation equipment, hot-work history and worker competence.
Tyre and wheel evidence is assembly-, pressure-, condition-, task- and operator-specific and is not an exact parcel-level explosion probability.
Disinfectant risk depends on active chemistry, concentration, incompatibilities, application method, aerosol generation, ventilation and re-entry timing.
Disinfectant evidence is product-, process-, concentration-, exposure- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level poisoning probability.
Food-machinery risk depends on machine type, guarding, access, intervention frequency, cleaning, maintenance, product flow and worker competence.
Food-machinery evidence is machine-, process-, task-, maintenance- and operator-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Processing risk depends on species, process, knife and machinery use, temperature, hygiene chemicals, biological material and task repetition.
Meat, poultry and fish evidence is process-, product-, exposure-, equipment- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury or illness probability.
Dairy risk depends on product line, wetness, cleaning chemistry, refrigeration, machinery, tanker traffic, temperature and work organisation.
Dairy evidence is process-, chemical-, machine-, transport- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury or respiratory-risk probability.
Drink-manufacturing risk depends on beverage process, container type, wetness, machinery, dust, noise, cleaning chemistry and material handling.
Drink-industry evidence is process-, container-, machine-, exposure- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury or lung-disease probability.
